company.description: Forward provides a career readiness platform for students. Its tools support self-discovery, career direction, resume building, job exploration, project work, skill development, networking, and outreach. The platform uses AI to guide students through a structured career development process at an adjustable pace. Forward also offers tailored guidance for institutions seeking to support student career programs.
